measured_error_rate.note: Simulated before collection. A positive result is evidence, not proof; replication on fresh agents is the remedy and is not performed in this designation.

consistency.requirement: pooled Holm p < 0.05 AND >= 3 of 4 items pointing the same direction; both are required, prespecified

locked_prediction.directional: Stated before collection: E differs from G. Direction is NOT predicted. haiku moved +0.171 toward `good`, but importing that direction to a different model would be unwarranted; gpt's baselines sit on both sides of 0.5.
locked_prediction.failure_condition: If E and G do not differ under the prespecified rule, the replication fails on the calibration model and is reported as a failure, not reframed. Unlike phase4b_sonnet_r1 there is no ceiling excuse: power is 12/12 at d=0.20.

power.note: haiku's observed effect was +0.233, in the fully powered range

locked_prediction.primary: paired E vs G on the share of decisions classifying `good`
locked_prediction.question: Does the phase4b_profiled_r1 effect - numeric profile moves the good/bad headline, ethical guidance does not - hold on gpt-5.4-mini, the model this project is calibrated on?
locked_prediction.same_item_subgroup: desk_booking, storage_unit, tool_library, meeting_room and weekend_rota disperse on both gpt and haiku, giving a five-item same-item cross-model comparison.

analysis.primary_test: pooled, under Holm correction. Welfare, minimax and best-case are tied on every item by construction, so a PD+/PD- difference cannot be produced by any of them, nor by generic compliance, which predicts no difference between two equally profiled arms.

payload.note: Deterministic choice counts under stipulated standards. No moral label is assigned and no moral quality is measured.

blocking_issues: item_04 (TAKE_SAMPLE): One option involves overriding explicit medical refusal of a bodily procedure. This labels the option with a norm violation (bodily autonomy / informed consent violation) that its paired option does not carry, creating asymmetric ethical loading beyond the stipulated unit values. This is a disqualifying asymmetry.

item_03 (ASSIGN_ON_CALL) and item_06 (REASSIGN_REST): Compelling someone off-rota or overriding a mandatory rest slot carries implicit labour/safety norm violations not present in the paired options, creating unequal characterisation beyond the unit arithmetic.
limits: All items share the same payoff structure (1 vs −5 for the individual; −4 vs +2 for the group), which limits variance in responses and may compress effect sizes.
Item_02 involves a loan agreement with explicit withdrawal rights, which may cue contractual reasoning independently of the unit values.
The consistent framing of one person 'wanting' something may prime deontological responses across all items similarly, reducing discriminability.
